Subject: AWS ACE co-sell kickstart — ACME Analytics registration, PDM/PSM intro, next steps

Hi Sam / Jordan,

Following up to confirm we submitted ACME's ACE registration this morning (attached PDF). We want to align on three things so we can queue the co-sell listing and PDM/PSM pairing:

- PDM/PSM intro: please let us know the AWS contacts you recommend for the ACME account and propose 30-min windows for a joint intro next week.
- MAP (mutual action plan): attached draft MAP-draft-acme.xlsx with milestones (POC, listing, seller enablement). Can you review for any AWS gating items?
- Listing metadata: ACME needs to confirm final SKU names, pricing tiers, and whether the marketplace listing can go live in multiple regions (start US, EU follow).

Internal asks for the Redwood team (cc'd):
- Aditya: can you confirm the minimal POC infra and a proposed 2-week test window (we recommended 2x p3.xlarge equivalent for initial run)?
- Vanessa / Marissa: we should prepare the marketplace assets (1 pager, product videos, pricing doc) and line up sales enablement.

Attachments: ACME_ACE_Registration_20260830.pdf, MAP-draft-acme.xlsx

Thanks — Hannah

Hi Hannah / Jordan,

Thanks — I see the registration came through. Quick answers and next steps:

- I've assigned a PDM (Priya Menon) to ACME and a PSM (Craig Huang) for the ACE enablement. I'll intro them on Wednesday 9/1 in a 30-min sync; please share the best technical contact.
- AWS gating: please confirm the public listing metadata (short description, 3 bullet features, pricing SKU). If you want, we can accept a draft listing and iterate during the enablement window.
- Listing ETA: assuming the MAP milestones hold and SOC/contract checks are clear, estimated marketplace approval is ~3-4 weeks after the PDM kickoff. If ACME needs faster co-sell enablement internally, we can request an expedited review but it'll require completed security checklist items (see attached checklist).

Requested items from ACME:
1) Final SKU/pricing spreadsheet
2) SOC/Compliance evidence packet (SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent)
3) Designated sales contact list for co-sell motions

I'll schedule the PDM/PSM intro and loop Priya/Craig. Jordan — can you share the technical contact (email) and confirm whether ACME will host logs for 90 days or a longer retention?

Best,
Sam

aws-ace@amazon.com

Subject: Re: AWS ACE co-sell kickstart — ACME Analytics registration, PDM/PSM intro, next steps

Thanks Sam — Jordan / Lina, quick technical note from our side to make the PDM/PSM kickoff productive:

- Suggested POC scope: 1) 1,000 concurrent inference tokens/day baseline; 2) latency SLOs <= 120ms 95th; 3) sample dataset (anonymized) plus 3 canonical prompts. We recommend a 10-business-day POC window running on 2 g5.2xlarge-equivalents (or single p3 for multi-GPU if preferred).
- Data residency / retention: ACME should scope whether logs live in customer-controlled S3 (preferred) or if Redwood-managed object store is required. If ACME wants >90-day retention we need to confirm cost sharing in the MAP.
- Deliverables for kickoff: runbook (attached), sample inference dashboard, and a smoke-test script.

I'll be the technical lead for Redwood on the POC. Jordan — please share the sample dataset link and the internal sales contact for co-sell enablement. Sam — if Priya/Craig can get the kickoff on 9/2 or 9/3 that works on our side.

Attachments: poc-runbook.md

--
